title: Secret Level
description: Adult animated series of original short stories which are set within the worlds of beloved video games. Each episode serves as a gateway to a new adventure, unlocking exciting worlds from beloved gaming classics and highly anticipated new titles.

episodes_data.title: Secret Level Season 1 Episode 1
episodes_data.description: On the hunt for a dragon cult, a band of adventurers rescues a boy who's haunted by a sinister force.

episodes_data.title: Secret Level Season 1 Episode 2
episodes_data.description: A young martial artist bent on revenge learns the true cost of his obsession.

episodes_data.title: Secret Level Season 1 Episode 3
episodes_data.description: A conquering king washes ashore on a mysterious island with no army and no clue. He may need an eternity to find his purpose.

episodes_data.title: Secret Level Season 1 Episode 4
episodes_data.description: After revolting against their corporate overlords, a group of mining robots is condemned to fight for survival in deadly arena combat.

episodes_data.title: Secret Level Season 1 Episode 5
episodes_data.description: In the grim darkness of the far future, a genetically-engineered warrior who has served on the front lines for centuries confronts his legacy, as his squad hunts down a mutant sorcerer.

episodes_data.title: Secret Level Season 1 Episode 6
episodes_data.description: Trapped in a vast maze and pursued by ghosts, a mysterious entity summons a warrior to help it escape.

episodes_data.title: Secret Level Season 1 Episode 7
episodes_data.description: As a looming storm approaches, two rival mercenary groups collide. Driven by their vision of the greater good, the sides face off, their lives hanging in the balance.

episodes_data.title: Secret Level Season 1 Episode 8
episodes_data.description: In a frostbitten frontier world, a legendary mech pilot learns his latest mission might hold the key to the demons that have haunted him for decades.

episodes_data.title: Secret Level Season 1 Episode 9
episodes_data.description: An orphan from a galactic backwater crosses the cosmos to take a job at a ruthless mega-corporation in the hopes of reuniting with the girl he loves.

episodes_data.title: Secret Level Season 1 Episode 10
episodes_data.description: As the corrupted creations of genius inventor Dr. Light rampage through Mega City, the humblest of his inventions dreams of fighting for everlasting peace.

episodes_data.title: Secret Level Season 1 Episode 11
episodes_data.description: A mechanic traverses the galactic frontier, racing against time in search of his runaway daughter.

episodes_data.title: Secret Level Season 1 Episode 12
episodes_data.description: A pair of explorers ponder their purpose in a subterranean world where everything wants to kill them. Repeatedly.

episodes_data.title: Secret Level Season 1 Episode 13
episodes_data.description: Captain Cassidy's crew of Freegunners is about to pull off the biggest heist of their lives – now there's only a deadly armada and a cosmos-sundering space storm between them and freedom.

episodes_data.title: Secret Level Season 1 Episode 14
episodes_data.description: An orphaned prodigy challenges the all-knowing artificial intelligence that rules his city.

episodes_data.title: Secret Level Season 1 Episode 15
episodes_data.description: Not linked to any one franchise, this episode focuses on a range of PlayStation characters tracking down a valuable item in a virtual world.
